scoring_justification: The paper's main claim is a positive correlation for LiSi and negative for Li2Si. The checker recomputes Spearman correlation coefficients directly from the CSV columns, comparing to thresholds derived from the paper (≥0.7 for LiSi, ≤-0.7 for Li2Si). No hidden labels or external ground truth are needed.

outputs.description: Each row corresponds to one LiSi amorphous configuration. The checker will compute Spearman rank correlation between D_Li and channel_area_fraction and require rho >= 0.7.
Each row corresponds to one Li2Si amorphous configuration. The checker will compute Spearman rank correlation between D_Li and total_microstructures and require rho <= -0.7.

output_contract.notes: The task omits manual structural modifications, ring-size breakdown for LiSi, and Li15Si4 phase per the agreed scope. The agent must generate its own amorphous configurations; no specific structures from the paper are required.

steps.description: Compute Spearman rank correlation between D_Li and channel_area_fraction; must be >= 0.7.
Compute Spearman rank correlation between D_Li and total_microstructures; must be <= -0.7.
